Introduction

Eungi is a South Korean singer, model, and actress under Big Ocean ENM. She is a member of the girl group iii, a former member of the girl group HI CUTIE, and was a predebut member of the group LURA LUCY.

She first debuted as a soloist on December 27, 2017, with the digital single "Today". In 2018, she joined HI CUTIE and made her group debut with them on May 2, 2018, through the release of their third digital single "8th Grade Syndrome". On June 30, 2023, it was announced that Eungi had left the group, but will continue her solo activities under the agency.

On July 23, 2025, she was announced as a member of the girl group iii and debuted with them on August 29, 2025.
